shortDescription: Ethereum rose 56.51% in the third quarter this year, marking its third-best quarterly performance on record. According to PANews, Coinglass data cited by Cointelegraph showed that only two previous third quarters posted larger gains than this year.

title: Ethereum Rises 56.51% in the Third Quarter, Ranking Third-Best on Record
